messages:
maria: FYI customer Shoply (EU tenant) reports ~50% of traffic landing in us-east instead of frankfurt. result: high P95 (200-800ms), some 401s and a sudden billing spike. sample request-id: req_0a9f33. attaching dig + curl outputs below.
sam: can you paste the dig output + sample client IPs? any recent routing rollout?
maria: dig from their office:```
; <<>> DiG 9.11.3 <<>> shoply.api.redwood.ai
;; global options: +cmd
;; QUESTION SECTION:
;shoply.api.redwood.ai.         IN      A
;; ANSWER SECTION:
shoply.api.redwood.ai.  60      IN      A       34.201.12.45   ; us-east
```
Client IPs: 84.12.55.101, 84.12.55.102 (EU ISP). curl trace:```
> curl -v -H "X-Request-ID: req_0a9f33" "https://shoply.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate"
* Connected to shoply.api.redwood.ai (34.201.12.45) port 443
< HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
```
luis: I ran a local repro from an EU VPN, same behavior — A resolves to us-east IP. quick dig +trace shows the authoritative response coming back with US region A. looks like resolver path returning wrong geo answer.
priya: customer says their ISP strips EDNS/Client-Subnet. classic case: resolver can't forward client subnet, so upstream geo-ip picks location from resolver IP (often US cloud peering). can we check our GeoIP DB last refresh?
eng-runtime: quick check: geodb last full refresh 2024-11-02. incremental updates daily but there was a sync failure on 2505500000 for some ASNs. ASN 39524 (their ISP) mapping currently points to US due to stale geodb. also seeing edge routing fallback policy is country-based and falls back to us-east when eu capacity is constrained.
priya: that matches: ISP uses shared resolvers hosted in cloud provider that geolocates to us-east. plus large resolver TTL (86400) so cache persists.
sam: can we mitigate quickly? options: 1) force geodb refresh and edge cache purge for FR/DE POPs 2) temporarily change fallback to prefer latency-based POP selection for this tenant 3) ask customer to enable region hint header or use a eu-dedicated endpoint. Preferred fast path?
infra: I'm kicking off a geodb refresh now and will purge POP cache for FRA and AMS. ETA ~15m. I'll also open a short-lived routing override for tenant shoply -> prefer eu-pop unless latency > 1s.
priya: customer workaround: they can set X-Region: eu in their SDK to force eu routing until we fully resolve. share code snippet.```
// JS example
fetch(url, {headers: {"X-Region": "eu", "X-Request-ID": "req_0a9f33"}})
```
luis: repro steps I used (to confirm): 1) connect via EU residential VPN 2) dig shoply.api.redwood.ai 3) curl with X-Request-ID and record resolved IP + response code. reproduces consistently.
eng-runtime: long-term fix: we'll harden geoip merges, add ASN-level overrides for known ISP resolver PO P mappings, and add alerting when large % of EU tenants route outside region. creating engineering ticket ENG-7892.
inc-bot: Created INC-4321: "Shoply EU routing -> us-east causing latency/401/billing". Assigned to infra, eng-runtime.
ops-bot: INC-4321 updated: geodb refresh started; edge cache purge queued; customer notified with temporary header workaround.
maria: customer notified and accepted header workaround. monitoring metrics, will update thread with P95 after purge. thanks all :thumbsup:
